verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an official Python package for writing scripts that control and extend the app, described in its docs and GitHub README as full automation and customization. Community users independently praise it, and AppleScript support adds a second official scripting interface. Missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Python, and in-pack evidence of API reference depth or versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: iTerm2 offers a Python package which makes it easy to write Python scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior.
Python Scripting API - Full automation and customization via Python. Create custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features.
Python scripting API: basically AppleScript for iTerm except it lets you touch pretty much everything and it's not soul-crushing to write.
